modelInferenceConfigName.description: Name of the {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.ModelConfig} for the Llm.

conversationLimit.description:
The number of conversation QA pairs to store  and consider for rewriting. Default is 16 QA pairs.
When the conversation limit is exceeded, QA pairs are removed in a FIFO manner.

chatHistoryCombinationLambda.description:
The lambda to use for combining the latest question with the existing chat history.
This is an Optional parameter used to provide more conversational context to question answering model.
For example, the lambda can be used to combine the chat history with the latest question in a specific
format best suited to a given question answering model.

The expected format for `histories` is alternating Q/A in conversation order.
- Example: `['Q1', 'A1', 'Q2', 'A2']`.
originalQuestion is the latest question asked in chat.
rewrittenQuestion is the rewritten question created by question rewriter.
It returns the combined question and chat history.
- Example: `"Q1: ..., A1: ..., Q2: ..., A2: ..., Latest Question: ..."`

searchQueryFieldForHistory.description:
The {@link Genai.Query} query field to use when combining chat history in question answering.
This is used within question answering and question rewriting in chat.
